title: OPS Agent Map
description: The agent ids a repository's OPS prompts may name, and how each one maps to a real executor. An entry is a mapping, not a role description: it neither starts nor configures anything by itself. Lives at .guides/agents/agents.yaml. When the file is absent, the map is the built-in default: one agent, `guided-engineer`, with no profiles.

description.description: What this execution profile is for.

profiles.description: Native profile per agent host, keyed by host id (for example `claude-code`). The value is the profile file, relative to the repository root, and the file must exist. A host without an entry runs the agent as its current executor.
